Card Q&A.q: Can I specify this Digimon itself as the Digimon to delete for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, delete 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 purple or red level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 purple or red level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
Notes: ANIMAL COLOSSEUM [EX05] Limited Card Set ver.2
